sources.text:
Orlovačko Lake (Serbo-Croatian: Orlovačko jezero, Орловачко језеро) is a lake in Bosnia and Herzegovina. It is located in the municipality of Kalinovik.  The lake area is about 3.50 hectares (8.6 acres), and has a maximum depth of about 5.50 metres (18.0 ft).


== See also ==
List of lakes in Bosnia and Herzegovina
